entry.name: Hexxit
entry.description:
Gear up and set forth on a campaign worthy of legend, for Hexxit has been unearthed! Dark dungeons, towering spires, weathered ruins and musty tomes lay before you. Lay claim to riches or create your own artifacts, tame beasts and carve out your own story in endless wonder. Alone or with friends, adventure awaits in Hexxit.

Hexxit is a new collection of mods for Minecraft that put adventure above all else, in the style of old Dungeons and Dragons campaigns. Exploration is interesting, the dangers are greater and the sense of satisfaction of clearing out a dungeon is intense. The modlist is full of quality content from some very talented individuals. Be sure to head over to the donate page and show your appreciation!

https://www.technicpack.net/modpack/hexxit.552552

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash

# Function to show the download progress bar
progress_bar() {
    # Set the length of the progress bar
    local bar_length=50
    local progress=$1
    local done=$((progress * bar_length / 100))
    local remaining=$((bar_length - done))
    local progress_bar="["

    for ((i=0; i<done; i++)); do
        progress_bar="#"
    done
    for ((i=done; i<bar_length; i++)); do
        progress_bar=" ${progress_bar}."
    done
    progress_bar="$progress_bar]"

    printf "\r$progress_bar $progress%%"
}

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

# Get release info and download links
LATEST_JSON=$(curl --silent "https://api.github.com/repos/kettingpowered/kettinglauncher/releases/latest")
RELEASES=$(curl --silent "https://api.github.com/repos/kettingpowered/kettinglauncher/releases")

# Check if TAG_VERSION is set or if "latest" is specified
if [ -z "${TAG_VERSION}" ] || [ "${TAG_VERSION}" == "latest" ]; then
    # Select the normal .jar file (exclude sources)
    DOWNLOAD_LINK=$(echo ${LATEST_JSON} | jq -r '.assets[] | select(.name | test(".*\\.jar$") and (test("-sources") | not)) | .browser_download_url')
else
    VERSION_CHECK=$(echo ${RELEASES} | jq -r --arg VERSION "${TAG_VERSION}" '.[] | select(.tag_name==$VERSION) | .tag_name')
    if [ "${TAG_VERSION}" == "${VERSION_CHECK}" ]; then
        # Select the normal .jar file (exclude sources)
        DOWNLOAD_LINK=$(echo ${RELEASES} | jq -r --arg VERSION "${TAG_VERSION}" '.[] | select(.tag_name==$VERSION) | .assets[] | select(.name | test(".*\\.jar$") and (test("-sources") | not)) | .browser_download_url')
    else
        # Default to latest release if version check fails
        DOWNLOAD_LINK=$(echo ${LATEST_JSON} | jq -r '.assets[] | select(.name | test(".*\\.jar$") and (test("-sources") | not)) | .browser_download_url')
    fi
fi

# Check if the download link is valid
if [ -n "${DOWNLOAD_LINK}" ]; then 
    if curl --output /dev/null --silent --head --fail ${DOWNLOAD_LINK}; then
        # Get the file size for the progress bar
        FILE_SIZE=$(curl -sI ${DOWNLOAD_LINK} | grep -i Content-Length | awk '{print $2}' | tr -d '\r')

        # Download the .jar file with progress bar
        echo "Downloading server.jar..."
        curl -sSL --progress-bar --output ${SERVER_JAR_FILE} ${DOWNLOAD_LINK} |
        while IFS= read -r line; do
            # Extract the download progress percentage
            PROGRESS=$(echo "$line" | grep -oP '\d+(?=%)')
            if [ -n "$PROGRESS" ]; then
                progress_bar "$PROGRESS"
            fi
        done
        echo -e "\nInstall Complete"
    else        
        exit 2
    fi
else
    exit 1
fi

entry.name: LeviLamina
entry.description: LeviLamina is an unofficial mod loader designed to offer indispensable API support for Minecraft Bedrock Edition. It boasts a comprehensive API, an array of utility interfaces, a robust event system, and comprehensive support for basic interfaces. LeviLamina provides an expansive API, a powerful event system, and a wealth of encapsulated development infrastructure interfaces, forming a solid foundation for augmenting the Minecraft Bedrock Edition with additional gameplay features and functionalities. By leveraging mods, the process of extending Bedrock functionality becomes effortless, with a user-friendly development process and an adaptable approach.

egg.author: eggs@purpleflaghosting.com

It boasts a comprehensive API, an array of utility interfaces, a robust event system, and comprehensive support for basic interfaces. LeviLamina provides an expansive API, a powerful event system, and a wealth of encapsulated development infrastructure interfaces, forming a solid foundation for augmenting the Minecraft Bedrock Edition with additional gameplay features and functionalities. By leveraging mods, the process of extending Bedrock functionality becomes effortless, with a user-friendly development process and an adaptable approach.

installation.script:
# Install required packages
apt update
apt install -y lsb-release xvfb unzip jq

# Install wine
wget -O /etc/apt/keyrings/winehq-archive.key https://dl.winehq.org/wine-builds/winehq.key
wget -NP /etc/apt/sources.list.d/ https://dl.winehq.org/wine-builds/debian/dists/$(lsb_release -sc 2>/dev/null)/winehq-$(lsb_release -sc 2>/dev/null).sources
apt update
apt install --no-install-recommends winehq-stable cabextract -y

export WINEPREFIX=/root/.wine
mkdir -p $WINEPREFIX


# Setup display
export DISPLAY=:0
Xvfb :0 -screen 0 1024x768x16 &




# Install Winetricks
echo "Installing winetricks"
wget -q -O /usr/sbin/winetricks https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Winetricks/winetricks/master/src/winetricks && chmod +x /usr/sbin/winetricks

echo "Installing mono"
wget -q -O $WINEPREFIX/mono.msi https://dl.winehq.org/wine/wine-mono/9.1.0/wine-mono-9.1.0-x86.msi
WINEDLLOVERRIDES="mscoree,mshtml=" wine msiexec /i $WINEPREFIX/mono.msi /qn /quiet /norestart /log $WINEPREFIX/mono_install.log

# Install dotnet
echo "Installing dotnet"
winetricks -q dotnet10           


# Setup tty width so wine console output doesn't prematurely wrap
stty columns 250


cd /mnt/server || { echo "Failed to change directory"; exit 1; }

# Install lip
LIP_VERSION="$(wget -qO- https://api.github.com/repos/futrime/lip/releases/latest | jq -r '.tag_name[1:]')"
LIP_URL="https://github.com/futrime/lip/releases/download/v${LIP_VERSION}/lip-${LIP_VERSION}-win-x64.zip"
wget "$LIP_URL" -O lip.zip
unzip -o lip.zip lip.exe
rm lip.zip


if [ -n "$VERSION" ] && [ "$VERSION" != "latest" ]; then
    wine lip.exe install github.com/LiteLDev/LeviLamina@"$VERSION"
else
    wine lip.exe install github.com/LiteLDev/LeviLamina
fi


echo "Server Installed"

if [ -f "lip-install.txt" ]; then
    for package in $(cat "lip-install.txt" ); do
        echo "Installing ${package} from lip-install.txt"
        wine lip.exe install "${package}"
    done
    echo "Packages installed"
fi

variables.description: Version of LeviLamina to install in x.y.z format. Blank or "latest" will install the latest release.
